source.note: All four Go fixtures are mutually coherent (model gpt-4, id chatcmpl-123, content 'Hello, world!' -> 'Hello! How can I help you today?'). The selected_channel segment is null because the Go unit tests do not construct an llm.Channel. The upstream_http segment is null because the Go tests do not perform a real upstream round-trip; upstream_http would need an integration test fixture.

inbound_http._comment: Copied verbatim (as JSON) from inbound_test.go 'valid request' fixture: an OpenAI chat completion HTTP request hitting /v1/chat/completions with JSON body. The Go test builds Body via mustMarshal(llm.Request{...}); the equivalent JSON is inlined under body_json. httpclient.Request serializes Body ([]byte) as base64, so the literal raw body is preserved here under body_json for parity; no base64 was synthesized.

unified_request._comment: The expected llm.Request the inbound transformer must produce (the Go 'valid request' case asserts req.Model=='gpt-4', 1 message, content.Content=="Hello, world!"). Copied from the same Go fixture's llm.Request literal.

outbound_http._comment: Copied verbatim from outbound_test.go 'valid request with default URL' fixture: the OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest output. Go test asserts method==POST, url=='https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', Content-Type=='application/json', Auth.Type=='bearer', Auth.APIKey=='test-api-key'. The transformer also serializes the llm.Request to the outbound body; that body is the same shape as unified_request and is inlined under body_json. baseURL/apiKey come from the NewOutboundTransformer constructor args in the Go test.

client_http._comment: Assembled from two Go fixtures: (a) outbound_test.go 'valid response' provides the upstream httpclient.Response body (mustMarshal(llm.Response{...})); (b) inbound_test.go 'valid response' asserts the InboundTransformer.TransformResponse output has StatusCode==200, Content-Type=='application/json', body unmarshals to llm.Response with id=='chatcmpl-123' and model=='gpt-4'. The unified_response and resulting client body_json are identical here because the OpenAI inbound path passes the OpenAI-shaped llm.Response through. created=1677652288 is a fixed literal from the Go fixture (NOT a placeholder — it is asserted verbatim).

content.content: Hello! How can I help you today?
